annotation.title_clean: Implementation Plan of Shanghai Municipality for the Development of the Embodied Intelligence Industry
annotation.title_en: Implementation Plan of Shanghai Municipality for the Development of the Embodied Intelligence Industry
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Shanghai Municipal People's Government (published via Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Justice)
annotation.venue: Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Justice - Government Bulletin
annotation.summary_en: Shanghai's municipal plan to build a global hub for embodied intelligence by 2027. It sets industry targets and offers subsidies, vouchers and funds for R&D, public platforms, demonstration scenarios and industrial clusters. It also commits to standards development, a safety risk assessment framework, and multi-stakeholder governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2027: 100 leading enterprises, 100 application scenarios, 100 products, and output above 50 billion yuan.
Subsidies up to 30% of project investment (cap 50 million yuan) for key technology R&D; computing power and corpus vouchers.
Five public platforms: computing power, digital twin training, pilot testing, investment, leasing.
Demonstration applications in logistics, manufacturing, retail, healthcare and rehabilitation, and household services.
Develops a standards framework and a safety risk assessment framework with multi-stakeholder closed-loop governance.
